name: cbio-rcc-iatlas-immotion150-2018
alternateName: Renal Cell Carcinoma (IMmotion150 Clinical Trial, Nat Med. 2018) - iAtlas Harmonized
description: A randomized phase 2 study of atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1) alone or combined with bevacizumab (anti-VEGF) versus sunitinib in 263 patients with treatment-naive metastatic renal cell carcinoma. The reprocessing of raw sequencing data is coordinated by CRI iAtlas.
